trigger: New behavior or a bug fix changes executable behavior.
exitSignal: Each changed behavior has inspectable red-before-green evidence against real behavior, followed by minimal green and safe refactor, or a valid narrow technical exception.
evidence: A focused test was written before production implementation and failed for the expected missing or defective behavior.
The minimum implementation made the focused test pass, and any refactor preserved the green state.
Tests exercise real behavior, with mocks limited to genuine external seams.
Generated output, configuration-only behavior, or unsafe reproduction exceptions identify the category, technical reason, and strongest safe alternative evidence.
